The bf16 column PASSES the same test (0.399), so the defect is in the DEVICE column. of3t-refprec has no device gradient of its own and quoted those figures from other rows; it annotated the scope mismatch explicitly on the diffusion and msa_module rows ('over its own 547 / 51.1358 %') and not on the pairformer rows. Establishing it needs a device pairformer gradient at MODEL scope, which does not exist: of3t_gradients/cap holds only blocks 0, 23 and 47 as boundaries.

headline: SUPERSEDED -- see SUPERSEDED and THE_ANSWER.json. we do NOT reproduce OpenFold3's training gradient: of D72's three AT-OR-BETTER scopes, zero survive a direct comparison against upstream's own bf16 training step, and the only scope on the record that does is layer_norm_a at 0.2666 % of the model. The entire ACCURACY failure is the diffusion transformer's softmax -- computing it in float64 takes that scope from 129x less accurate than upstream's own training step to 1.823x -- and on diffusion_conditioning, 36.9462 % of the model, the port is 7.95x MORE accurate than that step and fails agreement anyway, by direction alone.
